about.bio:
I started as an engineer (B.Tech IT, VIT) and moved into finance through numbers. At ZenStreet.ai, a bootstrapped startup I co-founded, I built a 12-month revenue and cash-flow model for strategic planning and cut CAC by 10% with Power BI insights. At AKSK and Associates I reviewed housing-finance loan files and identified NPAs, which was my first close look at credit risk.

Now, in my MBA in Business Analytics at Delhi School of Economics (2025-27), I'm focused on how families allocate and protect their wealth. I'm building a private-wealth mandate dashboard that goes from investment policy statement to asset allocation, rebalancing and a one-page client review.

Toolkit: financial modelling, Python, SQL, Power BI, KNIME. CAT 2024: 99.81 percentile in Quant.

experience.desc: Bootstrapped startup. Owned client relationship management alongside finance and strategy: onboarded and managed client and partner relationships end to end. Worked with leadership, marketing and product teams to convert business goals into KPIs, dashboards and analytical models. Built a 12-month planning and forecasting model covering revenue streams, cash flows and growth scenarios to support strategic planning. Designed Power BI dashboards tracking user acquisition, ARPU, CAC and performance metrics, contributing to a 10% reduction in customer acquisition cost. Conducted scenario, sensitivity and impact analysis to evaluate growth strategies and improve budget variance reporting.

Analysed financial statements and loan documentation from partners including Indiabulls, DHFL and Aadhar Housing Finance Ltd to assess credit risk and business viability. Verified KYC, income documentation and property records, identifying non-performing assets (NPAs) with 98% accuracy. Automated due diligence workflows, improving process efficiency by 15%. Communicated analytical findings to senior stakeholders to support informed lending decisions.

experience.company: Radiant Hunters · Vellore, Tamil Nadu · Remote
experience.desc: Developed FP&A and revenue models to support long-term financial planning. Analysed revenue drivers and cost structures, enhancing forecasting accuracy by 12%. Conducted ROI analysis for marketing campaigns, leading to a 15% increase in brand-driven revenue. Ensured compliance with financial reporting standards and internal performance reporting.
